cascadeInspection: Independent review verified the authenticated Header12 anatomy against the final DOM, scoped cascade, form lifecycle, video lifecycle, focused tests, and nine render states. One full-svh ren-cover owns one flexible video/poster/scrim region and one responsive lower band. The band contains one h1, one description, one visible labelled email input, one submit, one legal line, and one real terms destination. Video autoplay is muted and inline; pause/play state is exposed; reduced motion starts paused on the poster; no-JavaScript preserves the poster, native form action, and legal link. At narrow widths the band and form stack; at wide widths heading/support split and field/submit align. No extra CTA, navigation, logo, dialog, chevron, duplicate control, clipping, framework code, primitive palette token, or chromatic literal remains.
